"""Image-only own-model raw/contrast inference and local sign verification."""
from pathlib import Path
import os,json,hashlib,sys,time
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;BASE=ROOT.parent;OLD=BASE/'coordinate-yolo-selftrain-20261015'
SOURCE=Path(r'C:\Users\Kahvia\.codex\worktrees\coordinate-offline-evaluation\WWMAP-TOOLS')
os.environ['YOLO_CONFIG_DIR']=str(OLD/'settings');os.environ['YOLO_AUTOINSTALL']='false'
sys.path.insert(0,str(SOURCE/'tools/coordinate-ocr'))
import torch,cv2
from ultralytics import YOLO
from xy_decode import decode
from sign_layout import audit
from sign_recovery import recover
read=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def main():
 out=ROOT/'evaluation.json';assert not out.exists();training=read(ROOT/'training.json')
 torch.set_num_threads(4);weights=Path(training['weights']);assert sha(weights)==training['weightsSHA256']
 net=YOLO(str(weights));classes=list('0123456789-,+:');assert list(net.names.values())==classes
 previous_weights=BASE/'coordinate-yolo-expansion-20261015/training/expanded-200e/weights/last.pt';previous=YOLO(str(previous_weights))
 old={r['id']:r['detections'] for r in read(BASE/'coordinate-yolo-expansion-20261015/evaluation.json')['results']}
 old.update({r['id']:r['detections'] for r in read(BASE/'coordinate-sign-layout-20261015/historical-predictions.json')['rows']})
 cal=read(BASE/'coordinate-sign-layout-20261015/calibration.json');rows=[]
 def predict(model,image):
  p=model.predict(source=image,imgsz=896,rect=True,conf=.25,iou=.45,max_det=256,device='cpu',verbose=False,save=False)[0];b=p.boxes.cpu()
  return [{'char':classes[int(c)],'score':float(s),'xyxy':list(map(float,box))} for box,s,c in zip(b.xyxy.tolist(),b.conf.tolist(),b.cls.tolist())]
 for item in read(ROOT/'evaluation-inputs.json')['inputs']:
  start=time.perf_counter();images={}
  for variant in ['raw','contrast']:
   path=Path(item[variant]);assert sha(path)==item[variant+'SHA256'];images[variant]=cv2.imread(str(path))
  objs={v:predict(net,images[v]) for v in ['raw','contrast']}
  prior=old.get(item['id'])
  if prior is None:prior=predict(previous,images['raw'])
  context=cal['context'] if item['frameSize']==[2560,1440] else {**cal['context'],'frameSize':item['frameSize'],'imageSize':item['imageSize']}
  raw=decode(objs['raw']);contrast=decode(objs['contrast']);before=decode(prior)
  pipelines={'prior-raw-layout':audit(prior,before,cal,context),
   'new-raw-xy':raw,'new-raw-layout':audit(objs['raw'],raw,cal,context),
   'new-contrast-layout':audit(objs['contrast'],contrast,cal,context),
   'new-raw-recovery':recover(objs['raw'],raw,cal,context,images['contrast'],objs['contrast']),
   'prior-raw-new-confirmation':recover(prior,before,cal,context,images['contrast'],objs['contrast'])}
  rows.append({'id':item['id'],'context':context,'images':{v:item[v] for v in ['raw','contrast']},'detections':objs,'priorDetections':prior,
    'pipelines':pipelines,'milliseconds':(time.perf_counter()-start)*1000})
 report={'scope':'Own image-only CPU inference; truth read only in subsequent scoring. Raw and contrast same-pixel-ROI inputs.',
  'weightsSHA256':sha(weights),'priorWeightsSHA256':sha(previous_weights),'calibrationSHA256':sha(BASE/'coordinate-sign-layout-20261015/calibration.json'),
  'codeSHA256':{name:sha(SOURCE/'tools/coordinate-ocr'/name) for name in ['xy_decode.py','sign_layout.py','sign_recovery.py']},'rows':rows}
 out.write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2));print('Evaluation',len(rows),'images x 2 routes complete',flush=True)
if __name__=='__main__':main()
